container-grades-explained.title: Container grades explained — new, cargo-worthy, as-is
container-grades-explained.desc: What new, cargo-worthy and as-is actually mean, what each grade is safe to use for, and why the grade you pick moves the price more than size does.

container-delivery-access-guide.title: Container delivery and access — what the truck needs
container-delivery-access-guide.desc: Run-in length, pinch-point width, headroom and ground bearing decide every container delivery. What a tilt-tray, side loader and crane truck need.

buying-a-used-shipping-container.title: Buying a used shipping container — what to check
buying-a-used-shipping-container.desc: How to inspect a used shipping container: floor first, then doors, roof, castings and rails. What is cosmetic, what is not, and what the plates mean.

20ft-vs-40ft-shipping-container.title: 20ft vs 40ft shipping container — which do you need?
20ft-vs-40ft-shipping-container.desc: An honest 20ft vs 40ft comparison: cost per cubic metre, access, resale, and when two 20fts beat one 40ft and when they do not.

shipping-container-dimensions-australia.title: Shipping container dimensions — Australian reference
shipping-container-dimensions-australia.desc: External and internal dimensions, door openings, cubic capacity and tare weights for 10ft, 20ft, 40ft and high cube containers, plus clearances.

preparing-your-site-for-a-container.title: Preparing your site for a shipping container
preparing-your-site-for-a-container.desc: How to prepare ground for a shipping container: corner footings, levelling, drainage and clearance, and why a twisted container stops closing.

condensation-in-shipping-containers.title: Condensation in shipping containers — how to stop it
condensation-in-shipping-containers.desc: Why shipping containers sweat, why container rain ruins more stored goods than leaks do, and what works: ventilation, insulation and desiccant.

hiring-vs-buying-a-shipping-container.title: Hiring vs buying a shipping container — which suits?
hiring-vs-buying-a-shipping-container.desc: When shipping container hire makes sense and when buying does, how to find your break-even, what to check in a hire agreement, and moving costs.

container-security-and-lock-boxes.title: Container security — lock boxes, padlocks and siting
container-security-and-lock-boxes.desc: How to secure a shipping container: lock boxes, the right padlock, where to point the doors, lighting and sight lines, and a realistic view of risk.

shipping-container-modifications.title: Shipping container modifications — what is safe to cut
shipping-container-modifications.desc: Doors, windows, roller doors, lining, insulation, power and shelving: what can safely be cut into a container, what carries load, when to buy new.
